ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of a rectangular range of longitude and latitude lines; the longitude on the left is marked as about 73°40′, and the longitude on the right is marked as about 135°5′; the latitude line at the top is marked as about 53°31′, and the latitude line at the bottom is marked as about 4°. Then reason: this longitude-latitude range of the four territorial extremes matches the territorial characteristics of China, that is, this country is China. China is located in eastern Asia and borders the Pacific Ocean to the east, so from the perspective of the Pacific Ocean, China is located on the western shore of the ocean.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中矩形范围的经度约为73°40′E到135°5′E，纬度约为4°N到53°31′N。再把这些四至经纬度与世界国家疆域特征对应，识别该国为中国。最后依据中国位于亚洲东部、东临太平洋，判断其位于大洋的西岸。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个经纬线矩形范围示意，左侧经线标注约为73°40′，右侧经线标注约为135°5′；上方纬线标注约为53°31′，下方纬线标注约为4°。再推理：这一疆域四至经纬度范围与中国的疆域特征相符，即该国为中国。中国位于亚洲东部，东临太平洋，因此从太平洋看，中国位于大洋的西岸。
